tour_id.description: Unique identifier for the tour in the TourRadar system (please note that this is different from the operator code).

locale.description: Language locale the content is provided, default is `en_US` (English).

codes.description: Operator codes for the tour. Note that some operators offer the same tours in a number of variants (usually for different accommodation options), but TourRadar handles them as a single tour. For this reason, it's possible that more than one code refers to this tour.

language.description: Language code the content is provided, default is `en` (English).

tour_name.description: Name of the tour. Note that tour names are sometimes adjusted by TourRadar, and might not exactly match the name provided by the operator.

is_active.description: Determines if the tour is currently active, e.g. if it has departure dates that can be booked. Note: inactive tours are never returned by searching, but they could have existing bookings, so it's possible to retrieve them directly by ID.

description.description: Description of the tour, providing a summary of the itinerary and the key important selling points for the tour.

tour_length_days.description: Length of the tour, expressed in number of days.

is_instant_confirmable.description: If true, bookings related to this tour can be instantly confirmed by the operator.

guide_languages.description: List of languages this tour is offered in (for their meaning, see **[/taxonomy/languages](#tag/Taxonomy/paths/~1v1~1taxonomy~1languages/get)**).

start_point.description: Information about the starting point of the tour (e.g. pickup point), if available.

latitude.description: Latitude of the location where the tour will start.

longitude.description: Longitude of the location where the tour will start.

name.description: Name of the location where the tour will start.

address.description: Address of the location where the tour will start.

time.description: Time of the day when the tour will start.

end_point.description: Information about the ending point of the tour (e.g. drop off point), if available.

latitude.description: Latitude of the location where the tour will end.

longitude.description: Longitude of the location where the tour will end.

name.description: Name of the location where the tour will end.

address.description: Address of the location where the tour will end.

time.description: Time of the day when the tour will end.

budget.description: A market term that defines the price category of the tour.

max_group_size.description: Maximum number of passengers allowed on the tour.

id.description: Unique identifier for the tour operator in the TourRadar system.

start_city.description: The city where the tour starts.

location_id.description: Unique identifier for the city in the TourRadar system.

country_code.description: ISO code for the country where the city is located.

end_city.description: The city where the tour ends.

location_id.description: Unique identifier for the city in the TourRadar system.

country_code.description: ISO code for the country where the city is located.

images.description: An array of images for the tour. This is limited to 3 entries, plus the image of the tour map.

url.description: URL for the image on the TourRadar CDN.

thumbnail_url.description: URL for the image thumbnail on the TourRadar CDN.

type.description: Type of image, can be `image` for regular tour images, or `map` for an auto-generated image that shows the tour itinerary on a geographical map.

tour_types.description: List of the types this tour is categorised under.

type_id.description: Unique identifier for the tour type in the TourRadar system. For a list of all values, use the **[/taxonomy/tours/types](#tag/Taxonomy/paths/~1v1~1taxonomy~1tours~1types/get)** endpoint.

group_id.description: Unique identifier for the tour type group in the TourRadar system. For a list of all values, use the **[/taxonomy/tours/types](#tag/Taxonomy/paths/~1v1~1taxonomy~1tours~1types/get)** endpoint.

group_name.description: Name of the tour type group.

services.description: This section describes the various services provided with the tour (accommodation, food, and so on).

accommodation.description: Information about the nature of the accommodation provided with the tour.

is_included.description: Flag to determine if the accommodation is included.

description.description: Description of the accommodation components included in the tour.

accommodations.description: A detailed list of the accommodation options included in the tour.

type.description: Type of accommodation, for example: hotel, hostel, cabin, camping, etc.

nights.description: If available, the number of nights spent in this accommodation option.

ship_rooms.description: For cruise tours, the list of available cabin types offered.

flights.description: Information about the inclusion of flights with the tour.

is_included.description: Flag to determine if flights are included.
Flag to determine if the guide is included.

description.description: Description of the included tour guide services.

is_included.description: Flag to determine if travel insurance is included.

description.description: Description of the included insurance services.

meals.description: Information about the food services provided with the tour.

is_included.description: Flag to determine if meals are included.

food_options.description: Special food options available, for example: vegetarian, halal, kosher, etc.

optional.description: Information about additional optional services that the tour offers.

description.description: Description of available options for the tour.

transport.description: Information about means of transportation included in the tour.

is_included.description: Flag to determine if transport services are included.

ships.description: For cruise tours, this will identify the ship (or ships) used as means of transportation.

description.description: A short description of the ship.

hygieneprotocol.description: Information about the hygiene protocol that the tour operator will observe. This will include vaccination requirements, if any.

is_included.description: Flag to determine if hygiene protocol is included.

ratings.description: Ratings are collected by TourRadar from customers, after the tour is completed, and in some occasions provided by the operator.

overall.description: Rating out of 5 for the overall tour.

itinerary.description: Rating out of 5 for the itinerary of the tour.

transport.description: Rating out of 5 for included transport services.

food.description: Rating out of 5 for meals included in the tour.

guide.description: Rating out of 5 for the guiding services of the tour.

accommodation.description: Rating out of 5 for the included accommodation.

operator.description: Rating out of 5 for the tour operator.

reviews_count.description: Number of reviews related to this tour.

strict.description: This is the operator restriction for passengers on the tour (passengers outside of this age range will not be accepted).

min_age.description: Minimum age limit for passengers on the tour.

max_age.description: Maximum age limit for passengers on the tour.

recommended.description: This is the operator recommended age range, based on the activities part of the tour.

min_age.description: Minimum age limit for passengers on the tour.

max_age.description: Maximum age limit for passengers on the tour.

has_machine_translated_content.description: This flag indicates if the content in the current language was translated automatically (using a Machine Translation service), or is provided by the operator. It is recommended to display a warning in case content is automatically translated, and if the content is included on a public website, the page should be marked as `noindex` for search engines.

departure_months.description: List of available departure by month.

month.description: Month of departure date. 1 is January ... 12 is December.

location_id.description: Unique identifier for the city in the TourRadar system.

country_code.description: ISO code for the country where the city is located.

TourDestinations.description: List of all destinations included in the tour.

location_id.description: Unique identifier for the country in the TourRadar system.

currency_name.description: Name of the (primary) currency used in the country.

electricity_outlets.description: The electrical outlet types used in the country.

natural_destinations.description: List of the natural destinations related to the tour.

location_id.description: Unique identifier for the natural destination in the TourRadar system.

latitude.description: Latitude of the natural destination, if available.

longitude.description: Longitude of the natural destination, if available.

TourItinerary.description: Details the itinerary of the tour, with day-by-day description of the activities and the destinations visited.

order.description: The order of the itinerary item.

duration.description: The duration of this item in number of days.

locations.description: Locations visited in this itinerary item.

partner_info.description: Information about the partner-specific component of the price, including commission.

booking_fee_value.description: The actual booking fee value, calculated on the price reported in this section.

booking_fee_rate.description: The booking fee rate, if any, espressed as multiplier. For example, a booking fee of 5% would be represented by `0.05`. If no booking fee will be due for booking this tour, this will be `0`.

commission_rate.description: The commission rate, expressed as multiplier. For example, a commission of 5% would be represented by `0.05`. If no commission will be paid for booking this tour, this will be `0`.

commission_value.description: The actual commission value, calculated on the price reported in this section.

contract_type.description: The contract type your partner account is operating with for this operator.

calculation_base.description: Definition of the amount used as reference for the commission calculation.

based_on.description: If available, the type of accommodation that the base price refers to.

price_base.description: Base price of the tour, also referenced as brochure price. Note this is the lowest price among the possible departure dates (some departure dates may be more expensive than this).

price_addons.description: Sum of the mandatory addons that the passenger will have to pay (both upfront and local payments).

price_promotion.description: Discounted price, or base price minus the promotion.

price_total_upfront.description: Final sale price, composed by the base price, minus the applied promotion, plus the upfront addons.

price_total.description: Final sale price, composed by the base price, minus the applied promotion, plus the mandatory local and upfront addons.

currency.description: Currency code for the reported prices.

mandatory_addons.description: List of the mandatory addons (extra price elements).

local_currency.description: For local payments, the currency this payment must be executed in.

local_value.description: The price of the addon in the local currency.

ToursPromotion.description: Details about the promotion applied, if available.

id.description: Unique identifier of the promotion in the TourRadar system.

discount.description: Amount of the promotion (to subtract from the base price).

type.description: Type of the promotion (percentage discount, or 2-for-1 offer).

percentage.description: Amount of the promotion, when promotion is based on percentage discount.

pax_restriction.description: Maximum pax number to apply this promotion. If null - no limit.

value_type.description: Type of the value, can be absolute or percent.
